title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Vasanthi
desc: Released from prison after committing a crime, a young man learns about his orphaned sister. Soon, he turns to a life of crime to support her.

title: Thangamaana Rasa
desc: Thangarasu tries to make peace with his cousin who seeks vengeance against his family.

title: Anbe Sivam
desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

title: Palayathu Amman
desc: Asureswaran is cursed by a saint that a child, an incarnate deity, will be the cause of his death. However, when he tries to kill the child, Palayathu Amman comes to her rescue.
